title: Filolial Cross
paragraphs: “Wow! That’s so cool!”
Keel seemed really impressed—he was perched on Luna-chan’s head, lavishing praise on her.
My father was listening to the speech given by the one calling himself Filolial Cross, his eyes half-closed.
“Melty…”
“…What?”
“Seriously, is it okay if we run away from here? You too… How about we go live somewhere quiet, far away from those guys?”
“That’s a very tempting offer. I’m starting to feel like running away, too.”
“Naofumi-sama, Melty-chan, keep a level head!”
My Big Sister was firing off a tirade at my Father and the others.
“Sigh… I get your point… I’ll set up a place for us to talk, so come with me… Is that okay?”
“We thank the Shield Hero for his cooperation!”
With that, we arrived at Melromarc Castle, accompanied by the members of the Divine Bird Knights.
“Then I’ll act as the representative!”
Saying that, Filolial Cross addressed the members of the Divine Bird Knights and led them into the castle.
“Oh, is that…!?”

As we entered the castle, an elderly soldier stood at attention and saluted. His posture was far more precise than anything my Father or I had ever seen. It was obvious at a glance that he was incredibly nervous.
“Sigh… I wonder what I’m supposed to tell Mother.”
“I feel for you… How did it come to this? Is it really because of Filolial’s brainwashing…?”
“Boo…”

My Finacée, my Father, and the others—including Ogi-butan—are walking along, muttering something in a lamenting tone. By the way, I just noticed—they’re speaking as if they’re trying to alter their voices as much as possible, but this Filolial mask… isn’t it just Trash? I can’t shake the feeling that it is. They’re wearing full-face, Filolial-style iron masks and cloaks to hide their figures.
Still… how did that elderly soldier from Melromarc—who shouldn’t have had a proper conversation with us—figure it out so instantly? Eventually, we arrived at the throne room of Melromarc.
“Welcome. Um… Lord Iwatani and the Divine Bird Knights…”
The queen bowed, turned her gaze toward Filolial Cross, and then fell silent.

“My name is Cross! Please call me Filolial Cross! Are you the king of this country? I serve as the representative of the Divine Bird Knights from another world. And this here is Lord Gaelion, the Demon King from that other world.”
“Ah… it’s been a while.”

Introduced out of the blue, my rival greets the queen while in “baby dragon mode,” playing rock-paper-scissors. It feels a bit awkward, doesn’t it? Lately, my rival has always seemed so composed—this is quite unusual.
“I-I see…”
Since my Father and the others quickly made their way over to the queen’s side, we followed suit and approached as well. Then, a private conversation began.
“Hey? You know what that is, don’t you? Is it because she’s my wife or something?”
“No, that’s not it. That’s Rouge… no, it’s almost exactly the same as how the Wise King of Wisdom used to look in his youth—though it’s different from a mask, of course.”
“Hey, did he really do something like that when he was young?”
“No way…”
“How should I put it… He’s truly been reborn as the Wise King of Wisdom… My heart feels so light.”
The Queen answered my Father’s question, her cheeks flushed like a dreamy young girl.
“Melty, that’s your father—the man whose name once echoed throughout the land. Isn’t it wonderful?”
“Mother… I cannot agree with that from the bottom of my heart.”
Did Trash really defend Melromarc from Siltvelt’s invasion while dressed like that in his youth? This is some outrageous information coming to light.
“A strategy guide and a decoder.”
“I know nothing of it.”
“I’d heard of his exploits, but I had no idea it was something like that. There’s no doubt that was an awakening that should never have been triggered.”
“After smashing Ren and Itsuki to pieces, what the hell are you even talking about…”
“I suspect Lord Naofumi has already gone quite mad as well.”

My Father is completely ignoring Big Sister’s remark and petting her. It’s practically become a habit for him to relieve stress. My sister’s rough-textured fur, as she’s being petted, is glossy and shiny.
“Is the discussion over? Then let’s hold peace talks right here!”
The Trash—I mean, Kuro—who had been waiting obediently, made a proposal.
“Ah, ah… But what exactly are we going to do?”
“First, on behalf of our world, Lord Glass would like to formally apologize for the disrespect he showed toward this world’s Four Holy Heroes.”
“Bubub…”
Ogi-butan is saying something.
“‘Now that things have come to this, we have no choice but to apologize…’ is what he says.”
“…All the characters in black-and-white kimonos are standing together. It’s a dream collaboration. The characters overlap… or maybe not.”
My father turns to Yuki-chan and Ogi-butan and says:
“It’s Yuki-chan’s magnificent appearance, Father!”
“Motoyasu-sama! Yuki is so touched!”
“Bubub…”
“I couldn’t agree more. Filolial is a toxic substance.”
Father is nodding in agreement toward Ogi-butan.

“That’s why, Glass… from now on, let’s go with Rough-type. Rough-types are great. They’re fluffy, not as noisy as Filolials, and they don’t brainwash you. If you, wearing a kimono, put a Rough-type on your shoulder, it’ll definitely look good on you.”
“Naofumi-sama, please calm down! You mustn’t recommend Rough-types to Glass-san with those dead eyes!”
“Rafu~”
Father is backing away from my father-in-law’s fierce demeanor.
“Things are starting to get out of hand here. Naofumi, calm down a bit. We haven’t finished talking yet.”
“True… If you’re just here to apologize, we don’t hold it against you. We understand the full story behind it, and I suppose it can’t be helped. Don’t worry about it. So, is this just an apology?”

“It’s not just that! First, the Order of the Divine Bird Knights would like to offer our cooperation in fighting the evildoers in your world. Those who usurp the name of the gods aren’t the only enemies of the world. Our enemies run much deeper than that.”
“So you want to wreak havoc over here too, huh…”
“No. Absolutely not—we—”
“I get it, I get it. You just want to get rid of those hopeless parasites, don’t you? Do whatever you want.”

In that case, which side would the Pig King of Faubrey fall on? People say he’s pretty dangerous, but since we follow the “an eye for an eye” principle, my Father and I generally don’t get involved with him, right?

“Furthermore, we possess the means to travel between worlds. Therefore, in the spirit of friendship, we wish to engage in trade and create a mutually beneficial arrangement! Let us join forces to develop the technologies of unknown worlds… so that foolish conquerors and evildoers known as ‘Tenseisha’ will never run rampant again!”
“I understand what you’re trying to say, but…”
Father turned his gaze toward me and my Rival. Well, yeah… we already resolved those kinds of issues back in our original world.
“Wouldn’t small interactions—as long as they don’t turn into meaningless conflicts—be fine? After all, we’re from different worlds to begin with.”
“Uh, yeah… I suppose so.”
The queen, having come to her senses, nodded as well.
“I thank the heroes from the other world and the Queen of Melromarc for their generosity!”
I guess that wraps things up for now, right?

“As for the requests, the Queen and I will handle them with each country. We can already sort a lot of it out based on what Ren and Itsuki—who are with you—have said… So, was it the Filolial Cross? As a sort of opening act, is that all you have to say?”
“That’s right.”
“Well then, it’s our turn next. There are no prying eyes here. Hey, Trash, explain why you look like that. I can guess, but there’s a limit to what I can figure out.”
Just as my Father called him out, Cross let out a small chuckle: “Kukuku…”
“As expected of Lord Iwatani, the Shield Hero—I pay my respects to your keen insight.”

As he said this, Kuro loosened his tightly fastened cloak, held his staff in one hand, and removed his iron mask. There, revealing himself, was Trash… but one who exuded a different aura than the utterly despicable Trash from the first world. Is that what they call “charisma”? His gaze is intense.
“No, quite a few people figured it out. They saw you as a reincarnation of your past self.”
Father steered his gaze toward the queen. The queen in question wore the expression of a girl in love, while her Finacée’s eyes were lifeless.
“Ah… I want to go on a journey somewhere. Together with Filo-chan… I wonder if this gloom would lift if I were fighting as Melphilo too…”
“Melty-chan, please pull yourself together.”

“Raphtalia-san… I’ve never envied the Spear Hero and Gaelion as much as I do today… After all, I have to keep supporting the world with parents like that from now on. I wanted to support my country with a more ordinary father and mother…”
Isn’t that a bit of a luxury? The first Queen of the World died once, you know?
“That’s because this Filolial Mask and cloak hide everything. I doubt there’s anyone out there who knows the true identity of the Filolial Cross.”
“Well… there are actually quite a few who do… but I guess worrying about it is a losing battle… Why did you escape and cross over to Glass’s world?”
“As for why I left the tower where I was imprisoned—”

And so, that Trash started rambling on about all sorts of things. By the way, he’s the type whose first-person pronouns—‘we,’ ‘I,’ ‘I’—are all over the place. I, too, used to say ‘I’ for a while out of loyalty to my Father and Filo-tan, but I grew out of it after a while.

“I wanted to protect them… my sister, my wife, my children—all those dear to me—from this hopeless world. For that, I would have sacrificed anything… though in the end, it only led to further conflict.”

Getting back to the story, it seems that when the Crimson Swine died from the Uroboros’s deadly poison, Trash realized the truth behind past events… and was apparently engulfed in endless despair. After all, it wasn’t a Demi-Human who killed his son—it was the Crimson Swine. That’s only natural. However, upon seeing the Tiger Girl—the memento left behind by my late sister that I had offered him—he apparently came to realize everything.
“Tyran knew everything. Even knowing that… he still bore the brunt of my rage.”
It seems he regretted how misguided and foolish his hatred had become… By the way, Tyran is Tiger Guy’s grandfather. Trash had defeated that grandfather in the past, hadn’t he?

And after hearing secondhand that the mastermind behind the “Wave”—who falsely claimed to be a god—had been planted within the Crimson Swine, he apparently reached yet another conclusion or something like that.
It seems Trash hasn’t the faintest clue that I poisoned the Crimson Swine. What a wise and brilliant king he is! HAHAHA! Should I spoil it for him right here?
I’ve been warned by various people—starting with my Father in my head—to “Stop it!” Is that not allowed?

Also, I hear that Trash has been constantly thinking about how to make amends to his Father… and to the Demi-Humans and Beastmen he’s hurt in the past, as well as what he can do for the world. Of course, during that time, he was also carrying out the queen’s punishments and taking care of the Tiger Girl. However, he’s currently atoning for his sins… yet he feels he must still accomplish something—he can’t just sit here enjoying peace when he shouldn’t be. Just as he was pondering his past actions—which he’d carried out while wearing a mask—a voice came from the window.
—And there appeared Fleon-chan.

Apparently, Fleon-chan had her eye on Trash. Come to think of it… she used to fly around cheerfully and sing in the mornings. According to Fleon-chan, she came over and asked, “Is just sitting here worrying and silently enduring your punishment really the only way to atone for your sins?”
“Damn it! That brainwashing Filolial… So she really did brainwash Trash too!”

My father cursed under his breath. Fleon-chan isn’t at fault! Just as she helped Itsuki reform, her sense of justice must have reacted to Trash. In fact, she seems to be reflecting on her actions and trying to be of help to Father right now.

But… I won’t forget what happened at Shieldfreeden! To get back up after being beaten like that—she’s insanely tough. Even after your daughter’s misdeeds were exposed and I killed her right before her eyes, she still got back up… Perhaps she really should be exterminated after all? But since Fleon-chan chose you… grr… well then, in the upcoming loops, I’ll make you atone for the sins of all the Filolial-samas who were never born—so brace yourself!

In that sense, wearing Filolial-sama’s mask is a good sign of repentance. All good deeds should be attributed to Filolial-sama. With this, the world will be enveloped in Filolial-sama’s love and justice.

“Just as I had firmly resolved to fight for the world, I heard that the threats in this world had already been nearly eliminated. At the same time, I heard that there were people in a place different from this world who were exposed to the threat of the Waves. And that this threat might eventually reach this world as well… So, thinking that I should at least make amends there, I took that first step.”
“…You must have heard about Gaelion from somewhere. You just went off to another world like it was a paintball game.”

“Gaelion was surprised, too. Normally, wielders of Holy Weapons shouldn’t be able to travel outside their own world… It’s likely a parallel world, but there’s a possibility the weapon recognizes it as a single world.”
So Rival lamented. Apparently, it had something to do with the parallel world being created right after the world fusion. That was the situation, then. I had absolutely no idea.
“So, after bringing peace to this different world and eliminating the threat that was trying to invade ours, we offered a peace treaty as the Filolial Cross to build friendly relations.”

“Ah… well, according to Motoyasu and the others, it seems they could take it down in a flash, but Motoyasu apparently has absolutely no interest in that world… And Gaelion seemed to be trying to throw Glass and the others a lifeline because he felt bad about the way things turned out.”
“Bub…”
Father sighed in unison with Ogi-butan.
“Bubu…”
“Ah, so Motoyasu was holding back even though he could have easily beaten you. It was all to unmask the ‘Three Heroes Church’—a cult that had been committing evil deeds over here.”
Father is grumbling about what a troublesome process it all was.
“That’s the story. The world was saved by the heroic deeds of you heroes. I can’t thank you enough.”
The crisis is over, after all. For now, I suppose our role as heroes has come to a temporary conclusion.

“However, the scars left by the gods and the reincarnated ones still remain. This is both my atonement and my destiny… Sorrow will eventually breed conflict… Therefore, I must eliminate every spark of sorrow that remains for future generations.”

Well, my Father from the first world did defeat the Crimson Swine itself. But it seems he’s acting with the future in mind—after we heroes have saved the world. After all, there are indeed many people who were wounded by reincarnated individuals like Takt. He’s probably concerned that their sorrow and hatred might have a negative impact on future generations. Given that Trash himself was filled with deep hatred toward Demi-Humans and Beastmen due to the Crimson Swine’s underhanded schemes, it stands to reason that he’s trying to save those who are in a similar situation to his own. For now, I understand Trash’s resolve.
“And to build lasting peace, we need a presence that can bridge the gap between those with different ideologies and appearances.”
“…Is that what you call the Filolial Cross?”

“We are still immature… We cannot understand others as they are, and we end up fearing and hurting them… But one day, just as Tyran, his son, and Lucia did, I will make a world where we can trust one another a reality!”
Trash declared this with an intense gaze. With a gaze like that, he could probably brainwash someone. I can sense that level of incredible determination.
“So when I’m in this form, I want you to call me Filolial Cross, Captain of the Knight Order of the Divine Bird!”
With a click, Trash put his iron mask back on.
